# FunctionGemma source license

The pinned mirror model cards declare `license: gemma` and identify the
Google FunctionGemma checkpoint as their base. The applicable terms are
[Google's Gemma Terms of Use](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms), which list
FunctionGemma in the appendix. A full text copy retrieved from the official
page is preserved in [`functiongemma.TERMS.md`](functiongemma.TERMS.md), with
retrieval date and source hashes recorded there. The official page identifies
its content as CC BY 4.0. Do not relabel these fixtures as Apache-2.0 or
MIT-licensed.
